limits: Five files capture unfiltered local grid states under full/Bamboo global scopes; a sixth captures actual full Brand Sales ascending order and nonempty Scope sort metadata. A nonempty local column filter is not demonstrated; root reports that this particular name-column menu has no filter.
Browser save/click/sort provenance is supplied by root; this agent independently reads the resulting file bytes and real API/column-adapter expectations without operating Chrome.
By Item leaf rates may be rounded by its API contract. Aggregate ratios are recomputed from additive evidence; individual rates or sales-per-area values are never summed.
These are synthetic local prototype exports; production fiscal periods, quantity UOM, selling area and PLR definitions remain explicitly TBC.
